facts: Official March 9, 2016 test patch reports a historical review and changes the Temple-to-Accursed Temple transition from Velious to Luclin.
evidence.limitations: Search-index excerpt available; direct fetch returned cache miss. No exact February 2002 patch date asserted.

facts: Accursed Temple catalog contains Gimlik Cogboggle, a Thul Tae Ew Tracker, the seven named Thul Tae Ew variants, boiling/bubbling/swirling ooze, acidic mass and pool of black ooze. Catalog also retains obsolete classic actors, so catalog membership alone is not used to date an NPC.

Cazic-Thule 2.0 acidic mass loot explicitly includes 27908,27859,27874,27851,27853,27913,27883,27888. Those exact eight IDs match local acidic mass loot table 14204/22598; this positively distinguishes the revamp encounter.
Exact Gimlik Cogboggle placement at y254,x-468,z18.6 is marked Luclin. Revamped ooze populations are also Luclin. Used with official historical-review era statement and exact local escort source.
The same Gimlik page labels NPC Vanilla but its spawn Ykesha. These contradictory metadata labels are recorded, not used as the deciding authority.
August 8, 2006 Shaman Epic 1.5 firsthand walkthrough gives exact Yoppa Greenthumb dialogue and Darting/Feeder Shark aggro emotes. Matches caller source and all three spawned identities.

Shaman 1.5 step 5 sends player to Yoppa in Cobalt Scar; the elder-spirit phrase spawns three sharks including Gnashing Killer Shark. Used only for later-chain identification, not importing quest values.
October 12, 2004 community quest investigation identifies Shakey replacement-head story as part of Fatestealer Epic 1.5.
Step 20 gives two Shakey noggins and explicitly distinguishes their optional scarecrow-illusion use from the epic itself. This is not a claim that the wisp is a required epic step.

Contemporaneous 2006 Plane of Growth guide identifies Reflective Viridian Lightstone encounter as only spawned by a rogue flagged for Guise of Horror. Exact local player source requires noggin52355, lacks lightstone52361 and spawns 127105; local loot binds127105 to 52361.

Lycanthrope's Cure is labeled 2006#3 and uses Wand of the Blood Curse on five fallen werewolves in Kithicor. Find the Black Cat is labeled 2006#4 and names Syxa Jewlborn, her missing cat and Scrumptious Jack-o-Lantern reward.
evidence.limitations: Guide calls the wand effect Blood Dose Antidote; exact exported spell 11658 is Blood Curse Antidote. Record this wording difference rather than silently substitute a spell ID.

facts: Mirrored Verant/SOE Misty Thicket dialogue matches Bidils' tale, merchant past, stolen Bristlebane treasure and Realm of Heroes service. This is the dialogue-only GM herald, not the later same-named raid boss.
evidence.limitations: Search-index evidence; direct entity-page request returned cache miss. This is supporting identity/prose evidence, not a verified current P99 Bidils placement.

facts: Realm of Heroes page lists Bidils in Misty alongside Lord Nethryn and the other city heralds. The 2017 patch mention describes later presence, not proof of introduction.
Prior trade review identifies Note to Stiggle 67053, odd-looking-spider transformation and Stiggles as Reactivate the Portals, tagged Lost Dungeons of Norrath and entered August 29, 2003.
evidence.limitations: Inherited public evidence extracted to hash-bound changes/p99-conversion-era-identity/stiggles-delegated-evidence.json from the earlier trade review. This worker did not request the robots-denied domain or claim fresh page access.

facts: July 2006 firsthand thread links quest 2634 and Stiggles in Dragon Necropolis, then resolves the page dropping from a tiny clockwork. This corroborates the exact later chain, not the introduction date.

P99 documentation describes North Ro raft to an Iceclad island, followed by a separate Icebreaker trip. Does not establish an always-active invisible proximity teleport or the source marker coordinates.
evidence.limitations: Search index accessed on review date, page indexed months earlier. No fresh live page retrieval or server test claimed.

facts: Kunark Era. Related Realm of Heroes quest rewards None (GM event); not proof of exact Bidils placement.

Classic jack-o-lantern page explicitly places actor in Unrest, despite emu_id20289 also matching the imported Kithicor holiday NPC. This conflict blocks treating names or emu_id alone as zone authority.
Velious non-quest ship traveling from desert island to cougar island. Not an invisible teleport marker.

compatibilityReview.conclusion: Numeric NPC-ID quest lookup is supported; iceclad/110115 is not a missing-name identity blocker.

Per-character durable proximity is supported, but normal registration for these static boat markers has not been verified. Public world-timer scope does not establish support for their proximity and player-transfer effects.
